[[Territorial Administrator]] '''Thaive''' was an individual who served the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the CSA biological [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Stephannis Koss]] accused the Authority of sponsoring the development of enzymes that could be used to foster deadly diseases, and Thaive subsequently issued a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 15,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for Koss' capture.
